channels.name: CK_t, CK_c
channels.purpose: Quarter-speed differential master clock; CA sampled at double data rate.

channels.name: WCK_t, WCK_c
channels.purpose: Full-speed differential Write Clock (4x CK); on-demand; frames write data.
channels.idle_level: Disabled when no transfer is imminent

channels.name: RDQS_t, RDQS_c
channels.purpose: Full-speed differential Read Strobe; DRAM-driven, edge-aligned with read data.

channels.name: CS
channels.purpose: Chip select; marks the first command cycle; bounds low-power-mode duration (replaces CKE).

channels.name: CA[6:0]
channels.purpose: 7-bit double-data-rate command/address; a command occupies two CA transfers.

channels.name: DQ[15:0]
channels.purpose: Data bus per channel (two x8 byte groups); double data rate at the WCK/RDQS rate.
channels.active_levels: Single-ended referenced to Vref(dq); VDDQ 0.5 V

channels.name: DMI
channels.purpose: Data Mask / Data Bus Inversion per byte group; write mask + DBI.

channels.name: ZQ
channels.idle_level: Connected to ground via external precision resistor

handshake_pairs.name: CMD_DECODE
handshake_pairs.rule: Controller drives CA[6:0] (two transfers) + CS referenced to CK; SDRAM decodes one command per the LPDDR5 encoding table.

handshake_pairs.name: WCK2CK_SYNC
handshake_pairs.rule: Controller issues CAS WS_FS/WS_RD/WS_WR; SDRAM locks internal WCK to CK before the transfer.

handshake_pairs.name: READ_BURST
handshake_pairs.rule: SDRAM drives BL16/BL32 beats on DQ at Read Latency, framed by the DRAM-driven RDQS edge-aligned with DQ.

handshake_pairs.name: WRITE_BURST
handshake_pairs.rule: Controller drives BL16/BL32 beats on DQ + DMI at Write Latency, framed by the controller-driven WCK; WRX fills without data.

handshake_pairs.name: REFRESH
handshake_pairs.rule: Controller issues REFab or REFpb (round-robin); SDRAM refreshes internally; tRFCab/tRFCpb.

handshake_pairs.name: LOW_POWER
handshake_pairs.rule: Controller issues a CA-bus low-power command (no CKE); the mode lasts until CS next goes high.

dependency_graph.common_rule: All commands are committed on the CA bus referenced to the quarter-speed CK (two CA transfers per command). The DRAM is fully synchronous to CK except for RESET_n. WCK and RDQS are enabled only when a transfer is imminent; the internal WCK must be phase-locked to CK (WCK2CK synchronization) before any high-speed read/write.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Read data on DQ depends on the prior RD command at the programmed Read Latency, framed by the DRAM-driven RDQS. Write data acceptance depends on the prior WR command at the programmed Write Latency, framed by the controller-driven WCK. Every high-speed transfer depends on a prior CAS WCK2CK synchronization. There is no per-beat handshake.
dependency_graph.clock_dependency: WCK (full speed) is locked from CK (quarter speed) via WCK2CK synchronization; RDQS is generated by the DRAM during reads. CA timing depends on CK; DQ timing depends on WCK (write) / RDQS (read).

power_pins.name: VDD2H
power_pins.purpose: Second core / periphery supply, HIGH operating point (DVFSC).

power_pins.name: VDD2L
power_pins.purpose: Second core / periphery supply, LOW operating point (DVFSC).

power_pins.name: VDDQ
power_pins.purpose: DQ / IO supply, reduced to 0.5 V.

ordering_rules.command_register_edge: Command/address registered at double data rate relative to CK (rising + falling); CS marks the first cycle.
ordering_rules.data_byte_order_within_burst: 16 (BL16) or 32 (BL32) beats per LPDDR5 column addressing (B0-B3 / C0-C5); writes start at a multiple-of-16 column, reads may use a non-zero B3.
ordering_rules.wck_must_be_synced_before_transfer: WCK2CK synchronization (WS_FS/WS_RD/WS_WR via CAS) must precede any high-speed transfer.
